name: finding-sports
description: Find your next game - A platform for discovering drop-in sports games

scripts.backend: cd mockup/backend && npm install && npm start
scripts.dev: npm run backend & npm run start:auto
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:frontend: cd mockup && eslint js/**/*.js onboarding/*.js auth/*.js --fix
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:check:frontend && npm run lint:check:backend
scripts.lint:check:frontend: cd mockup && eslint js/**/*.js onboarding/*.js auth/*.js
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "mockup/**/*.{js,html,css}" && cd mockup/backend && npm run format:check
scripts.debug: npm run lint:check && npm run format:check
scripts.fix: npm run lint && npm run format
scripts.build: echo "No build step required for static site" && exit 0

author: Finding Sports Team
